# Didactic example: nginx/security.conf

# --- Proxy-level security headers ---
# Reinforced here in addition to the FastAPI middleware
# to cover error responses generated by Nginx
add_header X-Frame-Options "DENY" always;
add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
add_header X-XSS-Protection "0";  # Disabled: CSP is better protection
add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" always;

# --- Block unnecessary HTTP methods ---
if ($request_method !~ ^(GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE|OPTIONS|HEAD)$) {
    return 405;
}

# --- Request body size limit ---
client_max_body_size 10m;

# Exception for document upload endpoints
location ~ ^/api/(documents|imports)/upload {
    client_max_body_size 50m;
    proxy_pass http://backend;
}

# --- Block scanner user-agents ---
if ($http_user_agent ~* (nikto|sqlmap|nmap|dirbuster|havij|w3af)) {
    return 403;
}

# --- Block suspicious characters in URL ---
# Prevents path traversal and null byte injection
if ($request_uri ~* "(\.\./|\.\.\\|%00|%0d%0a)") {
    return 400;
}

# --- Block dangerous extensions ---
location ~* \.(php|asp|aspx|jsp|cgi|sh|bash|exe|dll|bat)$ {
    return 403;
}

# --- Nginx-level rate limiting (additional layer) ---
limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=api_general:10m rate=30r/s;
limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=api_auth:10m rate=3r/s;

location /api/auth/ {
    limit_req zone=api_auth burst=5 nodelay;
    proxy_pass http://backend;
}

location /api/ {
    limit_req zone=api_general burst=50 nodelay;
    proxy_pass http://backend;

    # Propagate traceability headers
    proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
    proxy_set_header X-Request-ID $request_id;
}

# --- Mandatory TLS 1.3 ---
ssl_protocols TLSv1.3;
ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;  # In TLS 1.3, the client chooses
ssl_ciphers TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256;

# --- OCSP Stapling ---
ssl_stapling on;
ssl_stapling_verify on;
resolver 8.8.8.8 8.8.4.4 valid=300s;
resolver_timeout 5s;
